newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi crown prince and Syrian president discuss in Syria ways of maintaining Middle East peace process.
- Saudi Arabia invests $500 million in Lebanon.
- Arab banks' union says ready to participate in an Arab tourism company to be set up with a capital of $500 million.
- Islamic Development Bank says it encourages the private sectors in Islamic states to finance development projects.
- Syrian foreign minister says Turkish-Israeli navies patrol waters only miles from Latakia.
- Trial of a Saudi national arrested in connection with al-Khobar bombing last year in which 19 Americans were killed is adjourned to Thursday.
- Gulf Arab states have not yet been invited to the economic summit to be held in Qatar in November, a Gulf official said.
- Arab experts discuss in Cairo privatising housing firms.
